generation.scope: All standard bisymmetric AS windows have opposite rank six or eight. Rank six is fully symmetrizable, and both rank-eight apolar pencils are quartic complete intersections. Factor partners are unique and opposite changes of coordinates are projectively equal in every rank. The transverse marked block has residual rank zero or two by PGL2 conjugation, while a radical line gives two coupled cubic forms and an alternating binary residual.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed factor-partner uniqueness, six-pivot elimination with nonassociative products, degenerate metric cubics, radical-row and column pairing, binary skew residual and the low-rank projective dimension argument.

mathematical_computation.scope: Transverse spin-factor fixtures with scalar, semisimple and unipotent transitions give 6,6,8,8,8. Exact radical-line fixtures with coincident or distinct identifications give 6,8,8,8.

tex.scope: Main 160 pages, plan 6 and notes 13. No overfull boxes, missing characters or unresolved references.

literature_review.scope: The new argument uses current internal results. No independent novelty determination or external-source claim was added.
